dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: I am curious, about Nara's way of farming. They don't praise flowers, or sing to fruit trees.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: But their way makes trees happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Do you know how they do that, Nara {NICKNAME}?
